simple.meaning: קָרֵב (qârêb) is a Hebrew object word meaning “near.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Numbers 17:28. The surrounding context includes family line, altar, kingship, priesthood, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָרֵב (H7131) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

timeline.evidenceText: and shall tell them, “Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against your enemies. Don’t let your heart faint! Don’t be afraid, nor tremble, neither be scared of them;
The Philistine walked and came near to David; and the man who bore the shield went before him.
The watchman cried, and told the king. The king said, “If he is alone, there is news in his mouth.” He came closer and closer.
When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly, and said, “Blessed is Yahweh today, who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people.”
The room which faces toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the duty of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to Yahweh to minister to him.”

It is a holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to minister to Yahweh. It shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.

definitions.full: H7131. qareb קָרֵב verbal adjective approaching ; — ׳ק 1Sam 17:41 +; plural קְרִבִים Ezek 40:46 ; 45:4 ; — approaching: 1 as predicate, וְק ׳הֹלֵח אֶלדָּֿוִד 1Sam 17:14 , לַמִּלְחָמָה קְרֵבִים אַתֶּס Deut 20:8 ; abs וְק ׳הָלוֺח 2Sam 18:25 ; c, article as substantive, 1Kin 5:7 (+ אֶלוֺשֻׁלְחָן ), Numbers 17:28 (twice in verse) (+ י ׳מִשְׁכַּן אֶלֿ ). 2 with article approaching ׳י temple or tabernacle, for service, with לְשָׁרֵת Exodus 40:46 (+ ׳אֶליֿ ), Ex 45:4; absolute הַקּ ׳הַוָּר Num 1:51 ; 3:10 , 38 ; 18:7 .
